olivia: CI red for nightly integ run — ~10 fails in hosted API suite, mix of auth + streaming + external tool failures. Anyone seen this yet?
ci-bot: nightly/hosted-api shard=19 failed. Failures: auth_handshake_timeout (x4), stream_chunk_mismatch (x3), external_tool_403_schema (x3). Logs: /ci/artifacts/2798765432/
sam: same shard showing up for me locally. Quick repro: `pytest tests/integ/hosted --shard 19 -k auth` — auth_handshake_timeout reproduces intermittently (~30% runs).
arjun: taking point to bisect — @olivia can you paste the last-green commit or range?
olivia: last green for nightly was around 2798500000. Most recent merges before this were in the 27986xxxxx range. Quick list: `git log --oneline 2798500000..2798765432 | tail -n 15` (sharing in threads).
arjun: starting bisection now. I will run reproducer with `--run-seed 1234` and capture tcpdump + pcap for the auth handshake. Will report first bad commit.
mel: FYI: we promoted an auth-proxy tweak (PR #4821) to canary yesterday — it changes keepalive/tls-socket behavior for streaming. Might be a suspect.
oncall-bot: Notice: cross-region fallback routing triggered between eu-west1 -> us-central at 02:12 UTC, increased latency to token validation endpoints — see infra alert #2798.
sam: captured logs from failing run: `ERROR auth: JWKS fetch 401 for kid: 'abc123'` then `stream: chunk out-of-order for conn 0x7f4` — smells like JWKS rotation + streaming window change.
arjun: bisection result: first bad commit looks like 2798690011 — changes to auth cache TTL and stream-buffer optimization landed together. Pinging infra for rollout confirmation.
tanya: infra here — that commit was rolled to staging then to prod canary at ~01:40 UTC; rollout paused at 70% because of unrelated metric noise. Rolling back the canary to previous revision now. ETA ~10m :hourglass_flowing_sand:.
olivia: thanks. Can we do a targeted rerun of nightly for shard 19 with the previous auth cache behavior? Suggested command: `ci rerun shard 19 --env OVERRIDE_AUTH_CACHE=previous`
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled by olivia: rerun_id=2798765600 (shard=19, env=OVERRIDE_AUTH_CACHE=previous). Will post results here when done.
sam: if rerun comes back green we should open an immediate revert PR for the auth cache change; follow-up ticket for stream-buffer repro/analysis.
olivia: sounds good — will draft the revert if rerun is green. Thanks all :raised_hands:
